thread:
rachel_csm: Quick heads-up — MuseAI onboarding on Vercel Edge functions is getting bursts of 429s during SDK init. They're in staging and customers can't finish onboarding. I'll paste logs.
nate_integration: acct=museai-staging, hosted. are they using Edge Runtime or Serverless? Any response body?
rachel_csm: Edge runtime. sample body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"preflight_concurrency"}. no Retry-After.
sara_sre: Edge instances spin up quickly and can cause stampedes. Do they fetch ephemeral auth inside each edge invocation?
rachel_csm: yes, token fetch + /v1/sessions in handler.
leo_devex: typical fix: move token fetch to module scope so warm instances reuse, and add a tiny startup jitter when initializing connections. Vercel Edge can reuse instances for a short time. Also add an "x-edge-instance" header so we can group.
nate_integration: can you share a tiny Next.js Edge snippet?
leo_devex: sure — pseudo: ```js
// module scope
let _token=null
let _exp=0
async function getToken(){
  if(Date.now()<_exp && _token) return _token
  const r = await fetch('https://auth.museai.com/ephemeral')
  _token = await r.text()
  _exp = Date.now()+45000
  return _token
}
export default async function handler(req){
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, Math.random()*200))
  const tok = await getToken()
  return fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${tok}`,'x-edge-instance': process.env.VERCEL_REGION || 'edge'}})
}
```
nate_integration: thanks. server-side we can do two things: 1) temporary per-account preflight bump for 4h; 2) enable a debug header on 429s in staging: X-Redwood-Limiter: preflight-edge.
sara_sre: will add that header and a log flag. ops-bot, open exception.
ops-bot: rate-limit-exception created (#EXC-8207) by sara_sre, acct=museai-staging, +120 preflight for 4h.
rachel_csm: MuseAI will apply the patch and repro in 10m. I'll capture full response headers during the test and paste here.
leo_devex: also tell them to implement client-side exponential backoff for 429s and to surface a friendly spinner while onboarding completes.
rachel_csm: on call now; will update thread after repro. :rocket:
